units.source_text: 名人是这场棋的对弈者，他这样承认了，也就没有问题了吧。

en.t: The Master was one of the players in this game, and since he acknowledged it that way, there was probably no problem with it.

units.source_text: 名人发怒，是因为这一手当时出乎意料。

en.t: The Master became angry because that move was unexpected at the time.

units.source_text: 他怀疑大竹七段的用心，也是因为在气头上产生了误解。

en.t: His suspicion of Otake 7-dan's intentions also came from a misunderstanding born in the heat of anger.
